notes.title: New Demo Update! Bonus 2026 Delay (╥_╥)
notes.notes: [p]We unfortunately have some bad news to share: the game's getting delayed to 2026. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45031409/9d17fa0296ed05d8dc604a8293ead307d1878c32.gif"][/img][/p][p]You may know that we were originally targeting a June 2025 release date... That didn't happen.[/p][p]Our only programmer is required to go into conscript service for 11 months (it's mandatory in Estonia), so we don't have much choice but to delay the game. We also underestimated how much work it is to rework all the game's cutscenes to be in-engine and to update other art, but this delay does give our artist more time to work with. [/p][p]We have a lot of cool stuff planned, so stay tuned for that![/p][p][/p][p]That was the bad news we had to share with you. Now, here's something a little better.[/p][p]The good news: we've updated the demo, fixing a bunch of bugs and adding some new content—as well as quite a few new languages! Try to guess what this one is:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45031409/7d68aa493e3baef1eb183ef52f372681192ba8ae.png"][/img][/p][p]As we couldn't hit our initial release goal, we decided to add some of the new content we've made into the demo. As such, it now contains all the new fixes we've done in the last couple months, alongside a few new outfits, new balls and even some levels. [/p][p]There's also the new languages, including Võro, a South-Estonian language - this is probably the first time it's been featured in a video game! Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Finnish, Brazilian (and non-Brazilian) Portuguese and more are also now available![/p][p]Take a look at the changelog to see everything we've added or changed:[/p][p][/p][h2]Changelog:[/h2][h3]Backend stuff:[/h3][p]Updated to Unity 6.[/p][p]Updated Steamworks SDK.[/p][p]Updated CRIWARE SDK.[/p][p][/p][h3]Content changes:[/h3][p]Added 6 new balls.[/p][p]Added 4 new outfits.[/p][p]Remastered the menu music and two gameplay songs.[/p][p]Replaced the final demo level with a fancier one.[/p][p]Updated the cutscene pause menu design.[/p][p]Added dynamic shadows to some levels.[/p][p]Added more animations to the elephant. They can now lean to either side and even jump. Sorry to all the mid-jump crouchers, though, because you can't do that anymore.[/p][p][/p][h3]Localization:[/h3][p]Added [url="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/V%C3%B5ro_language"]Võro[/url].[/p][p]Added Japanese.[/p][p]Added Belarusian.[/p][p]Added Turkish.[/p][p]Added Portuguese.[/p][p]Added Brazilian Portuguese.[/p][p]Added Spanish LATAM.[/p][p]Added Finnish.[/p][p]Removed Swedish.[/p][p]Added Simplified Chinese.[/p][p]Added Romanian.[/p][p]Removed French.[/p][p]Added Swedish back.[/p][p]Updated the localization files.[/p][p][/p][h3]Fixes:[/h3][p]Fixed text-rendering issues in Hindi. [url="https://sudonull.com/post/72710-Localization-of-Unity-games-in-Hindi"]Did you know that Unity doesn't have proper support for Hindi text?[/url] We learned this the hard way.[/p][p]Improved backflip detection. No more unpaid flips.[/p][p]Game no longer pauses when alt-tabbed, unless in gameplay. Now you too can watch the cutscenes while chatting on Discord on your other screen.[/p][p]Allowed the elephant to smile during gameplay.[/p][p]Fixed various edge cases related to menus, where you could mash buttons and make everything explode.[/p][p]Improved menu button animations.[/p][p]Fixed flickering on some scene transitions.[/p][p]Adjusted prices for inflation.[/p][p]Adjusted the anti-piracy check. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Visit us at Comic Con Baltics 2025!
notes.notes:
That's right!
On the days of May 23rd to May 25th, we're going to be attending the Baltics Gaming Expo at Comic Con Baltics. You'll be able to meet us there, play a new and updated demo, and it will be great!

Just look at all the people playing EleBall on the picture, provided courtesy of Comic Con Baltics. Well, they're playing CS2, but that's besides the point. Once again: Don't miss out!

notes.title: EleBall Demo: Out Now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45031409/1a4a2467e285371e4305be9db3bdfddfa9dfaa9e.png[/img]

Heads up, EleBallers! Our first demo is now available on the Steam Next Fest.
So what are you waiting for? Go play it!

This short peek at the game has the following amount of stuff:
[list]
[*]Over [b]SIX[/b] levels
[*]Over [b]ELEVEN[/b] outfits
[*]Over [b]TWO[/b] cutscenes
[*]and over [b]TWENTY SIX[/b] [strike]Ele[/strike]Balls!
[/list]
Click the button below to get your own free EleBall (demo), now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3416050

This demo will stay up after Steam Next Fest ends, so no need to worry about missing it. We hope you have fun! Check out our community forums if you have any bug reports or feedback, and share the game around if you liked it—it helps us immensely.
Thank you!

notes.title: EleBall Demo, just a week away!
notes.notes:
EleBall will be participating in the Steam Next Fest: February 2025!

We're putting out a demo to give everyone a peek at the game before the actual launch later this year. 
With over 6 levels, over 11 outfits, over 2 cutscenes and over 26 [strike]Ele[/strike]balls! There's even some achievements and a selection of different languages available for you to pick from.


We will be keeping the demo up after the Next Fest ends as well, so there's no fear of missing out.


And that's not all—the game also works perfectly on a Steam Deck!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45031409/d8c4de3edc238a60ad4a9d5332780171aa5126f3.png[/img][url=https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/steam-deck-502407f2dab048728e1b63699bf99d45]Credits to VM-Models for the Steam Deck model.[/url]

We hope you'll have fun EleBalling! If you've got any feedback you want to share, feel free to post on the Steam Discussions—we'll be active there.
